Added replacement for HAL_UART_MspInit to remove hardware dependencies. This function contains MMIO operations through clock enable macros (USARTx_TX_GPIO_CLK_ENABLE, USARTx_RX_GPIO_CLK_ENABLE, USARTx_CLK_ENABLE) and calls HAL_GPIO_Init which has hardware dependencies. The replacement:
1. Skips all hardware-specific clock enable operations
2. Preserves the GPIO configuration structure for compatibility
3. Skips hardware GPIO initialization
4. Preserves NVIC priority setting for compatibility
5. Skips hardware interrupt enable (HAL_NVIC_EnableIRQ)
This allows the function to work in emulation without hardware dependencies while maintaining the structure for compatibility.
